lines.t: (Inspired by YahuShua, the disciples, and TheVolumesofTruth.com)
Winds stir as voices rise on high...
Angels singing: “Glory to the Lamb! Glory to YahuShua, our King!”
(Verse 1)
We walk the narrow way, the path of old,
Where prophets spoke what Truth foretold.
From city to city, door to door,
We carry His Word forevermore.
No crown of gold, no earthly fame,
Only the power of His Name.
He calls, “Come forth, My chosen ones,
Shine your light till the work is done.”
(Chorus – Heavenly Chorus Enters)
🌩️ Thunder and voices resound 🌩️
Walking in Truth and Light,
Through the storm, through the night.
Angels singing, “Holy! Holy!”
YahuShua reigns in power and glory.
Hearts made pure, our garments white—
Forever walking in Truth and Light.
(Verse 2)
They mocked, they turned their eyes away,
But still His children kneel and pray.
The ancient path, the sacred flame,
We walk in reverence of His Name.
The trumpet sounds, the heavens blaze,
All creation lifts His praise!
The Bride prepared, her lamp held high,
The King is coming in the sky!
Walking in Truth and Light,
Hearts on fire, eyes on the fight.
Angels cry, “YahuShua lives!”
All glory to the One who gives.
City to city, shining bright,
Forever walking in Truth and Light.
(Bridge – Celestial Praise)
Heavenly chorus rises like mighty waters...
“Worthy is the Lamb who was slain!”
“Blessing and honor, glory and might!”
“All knees shall bow, all tongues proclaim —
YAHUWAH is the Name above every name!”
Walking in Truth and Light,
Thunder rolls, the darkness takes flight.
With angels singing side by side,
The Bride and Spirit unified.
From everlasting to everlasting bright,
We walk in Truth, we walk in Light.
“HalleluYAH! HalleluYAH!
Praise be to YahuShua YAHUWAH!”
Glory forever, power and might—
We walk in Truth, we walk in Light.
Walking in Truth and Light,
Through the storm, through the night.
Angels singing, “Holy! Holy!”
YahuShua reigns in power and glory.
Hearts made pure, our garments white—
Forever walking in Truth and Light.
